observed_construction.note: The current repository lists were materialized from the union of known targets and hand-maintained DISTRACTORS. This record describes the current data, not a formal catalog source.

ethereum.proposed_rule: Canonical protocol specification/API repositories plus maintained execution and consensus clients listed by the Ethereum project.

kubernetes.proposed_rule: Repositories named by Kubernetes project governance as core APIs, official client libraries, or SIG-governed implementation projects, intersected with repositories for which an observation-time snapshot can be collected.

opencontainers-runtime.proposed_rule: Runtime-spec implementations and conformance/tooling repositories named by the Open Container Initiative ecosystem, intersected with repositories for which an observation-time snapshot can be collected.

openstack.proposed_rule: Official OpenStack governance deliverables participating in the same release constraints, API, deployment, or client surface, selected without consulting the case target labels and intersected with observation-time snapshot availability.

opentelemetry.proposed_rule: Official OpenTelemetry language implementations and collector repositories listed by the project, intersected with repositories for which an observation-time snapshot can be collected.

python.proposed_rule: Python language, typing, and packaging repositories named by the corresponding PSF or PyPA governance surfaces, intersected with repositories for which an observation-time snapshot can be collected.

rust.proposed_rule: Rust toolchain and language implementation repositories governed by rust-lang teams, intersected with repositories for which an observation-time snapshot can be collected.

starlingx.proposed_rule: Repositories listed as StarlingX project deliverables by project governance, intersected with repositories for which an observation-time snapshot can be collected.
